create_TheseusFunction_subclass: create a subclass of TheseusFunction that implements _copy_impl for a custom cost function
register_optim_vars: register a list of optimization variable names on a TheseusFunction instance
register_aux_vars: register a list of auxiliary variable names on a TheseusFunction instance
copy_TheseusFunction: copy a TheseusFunction instance with a new name and optional variable name preservation
set_optim_var_at: replace an optimization variable at a given index on a TheseusFunction instance
